strings.en: We've wiped out the enemies around here, so now we finally go into Jaburo.
I hope we can get in without anything happening...
Last time, just as we were about to, the Aura Road opened up.
I wanna go back to Byston Well, but... I guess I can't, huh...
Still, that Einst... its actions aren't consistent.
Yeah, which makes its goal all the harder to read.
It was targeting Kyosuke... but why?
Do you have any idea?
I don't know why it's after me and Excellen...
Either way, all we know right now is that it's an enemy.
That red machine looked like it was commanding the Einst.
Then has everything the Einst have done so far been its doing?
(No, that's not it... From the voice that isn't Alchemie's,
I sense something like a different will...)
Kasshu, please come to the bridge at once... Major Ulube is calling.
From Ulube?
I have unfortunate news for you, Domon.
D-Don't tell me something happened to my father!?
Dr. Kasshu is quite well... though still frozen, I'm afraid.
What do you mean!?
You said you'd free him once the Devil Gundam's recovery was confirmed!
The Devil Gundam could not be recovered.
Major Ulube, you don't mean...!?
Yes, exactly that. The Devil Gundam was not in the Guiana Highlands...
That's impossible, I definitely defeated it...
By the time we rushed to the Guiana Highlands, it was already gone.
Then the Devil Gundam is still somewhere on Earth even now?
We don't know exactly where, but most likely.
I'm sorry, Domon, but as long as the Devil Gundam remains unrecovered,
Dr. Kasshu's release will have to be postponed.
Ngh...
Finally! Looks like things down here are about to get settled too.
Calm down a little, Pai.
Come on, Roll, don't rain on my parade at a time like this.
May I ask? ...Apart from Alice, you're all from other planets, right?
Why are you helping us?
We're Mia's friends. Of course we'd help.
Besides... we can't just ignore people in trouble...
Sorry about this. Earth's problems oughta be handled by Earthlings.
Really. But between Dangaioh and Grendizer up in space...
we're getting a lot of help from people from other star systems.
Yeah. But Daisuke, the Dangaioh team, Princess Romina...
they sure look like Earthlings, no matter how you look at it.
It's pathetic. To protect our own planet...
we have to rely on the power of other star systems...
True. Dangaioh, Grendizer... Maya's group's machines,
and Tobikage too, is a robot from the Shema system.
Aliens or not, they look no different from Earthlings.
That's probably why it doesn't feel strange.
Maybe, surprisingly, everyone was originally from Earth...
It could be the other way around, too.
Huh? But none of you have psychic powers, right?
Psychic powers? Oh, that's right, you four are espers.
They're pretty unstable, though.
Roll has to run to use hers, Lamba runs outta power fast,
and Mia can't control hers on her own.
Your "power" is just being super strong, Pai. Is that even psychic?
Shut up, stupid, that's me unleashing my full latent potential...
Come to think of it, Daisuke's little sister Maria has precognition.
I guess that's a psychic power too.
Captain Amuro and Kamille are Newtypes, right?
Is that... a psychic power too?
Come to think of it...
doesn't Daisuke's little sister Maria have precognition?
That's right. And they say the Captain and Kamille are Newtypes...
Is that a kind of psychic power too?
I don't think that's the case. "Newtype" is just
what other people call us.
We're just ordinary people with good intuition. Me, Kamille, and him...
How fascinating. I'd love to talk at length, but...
Save that debate for later, though I'm a bit curious. We storm in soon.
If your machines are serviced, get some proper rest for now.
You're right.
Wh-Where are you going, Domon!?
I'm going to find Master and the Devil Gundam!
But didn't you say you couldn't abandon the Gandor Team like this?
That was because I thought I'd defeated the Devil Gundam... Kyoji.
If the Devil Gundam still exists, then I know what I must do.
Domon...
Domon! In that case, all the more reason to stay with the Gandor Team!
Schwarz!?
What do you mean?
Kyoji... The Devil Gundam is here, in Jaburo.
What?
I followed him here. There's no mistake.
Then...?
It's right nearby...
If Kyoji's here, then Master Asia too...
Yes, he's likely lying in wait.
Then I'd better hurry and tune the God Gundam Major Ulube brought us.
Yeah, please do.
(But what is this nostalgia I feel from this man called Schwarz...?)
So we're storming in now. What's it like inside?
We don't know, that's why we're charging in all at once, right?
Even so, this is a real pain!
We gotta dive right in without knowin' what's inside, right?
Shut up, what're you whinin' about?
Joe, ain't your crew done with maintenance yet?
So what if we ain't? These machines were left behind by aliens.
There's a lot about 'em we don't get.
Blast Dragon's done, Big Bro. Why're you picking fights with other teams?
I get that you're on edge before we storm in, but do your job, Joe.
Lieutenant Amada's mobile suit team finished ages ago, you know?
Almost done.
Combattler's almost done, too. Ropet, how's it going over there?
Kosuke. No problems. Ready to launch as is.
All right, we're done! Now we just wait to sortie.
See? Joe, you're the only one who isn't done.
Tch, fine, fine.
Kurojishi and the rest are robots aliens built, right?
You guys actually understand 'em?
I don't really get the mechanical stuff,
but for some reason I can pilot this machine. Maintain it, too.
That's strange. Maybe they were actually made on Earth?
Come to think of it, the Elshank came to Earth hundreds of years ago,
looking for ninja...
The Shema system is 60,000 light years from the solar system, right?
And robots and mobile suits have only been built in the last few decades.
...The timing doesn't add up.
So basically, nobody gets it, right? Who cares?
It's just a coincidence they're the same, right?
The tech level, the builders' tastes, and all that.
I'm not sure we can sum it up that easily...
Hyoma. Simple. Single-celled.
What'd you say, Ropet!?
But... I never thought hard about it, but it is strange.
Princess Romina, Shaff, and even Ilbora...
they look no different from us humans...
So the robots' workings aren't the only thing that's the same, huh?
Though everyone from the Shema system has a lousy personality.
Come to that, three of the Dangaioh team are aliens too,
an' they ain't no different from people, right?
...Though walking around the ship dressed like that is a bit much...
...Yeah... true.
This ship will storm the interior of Jaburo in 20 minutes.
All pilots, assemble on the bridge.
I repeat, this ship will...
Oh, here it is, from the Commander! All right, everyone, let's go!
All right, here we go...!
Hey, Joe! You're not done yet!
Kurojishi'll be fine.
After all, I'm the one piloting it!
Lenny, nothing you say will get through to Big Bro.
Geez!
Combattler team, coming in.
That's everyone. ...Listen carefully.
The Gandor will now storm the interior of Jaburo.
What's the situation inside?
Still no contact with them?
Is it full of those guys in there after all?
That's sooo gross...
Waaah! I wanna go home! Lady Sheelaaa!
Yeah, it'd be bad if we got sent back to Byston Well again.
The Einst the other day said it had no business
with Byston Well, but...
Whatever, let's just sortie already.
An interception force would be trouble. Let's move fast, Commander.
We haven't heard from the princess. Is she gonna be okay?
...Questions and opinions one at a time, please.
First, the inside. Minovsky jamming is so heavy we can't get a read on it.
So they've got jamming up.
Want me to scout it from underground in Liger, Commander?
No, we have neither machines to spare for recon... nor time.
So basically, it's the Cyber Beast Force's specialty: just charge in, huh?
Well, I get that it's our only option.
Dawdlin' around till somebody calls a halt before we storm in is no fun.
Let's get a move on.
Pai... for all your talk, you're cut out for the Cyber Beast Force too.
The jamming is... of a strange kind we've never seen before.
In other words, it's not anything already known...
There's a good chance it belongs to that mysterious enemy.
Or it could be a whole new enemy, y'know.
Juzo, no need to go sayin' things that'll make us nervous.
South of Jaburo, the mysterious enemy was controlling AI robots,
wasn't it? Could it be that inside Jaburo, they've already...
Quite likely. They may be deploying even as we speak.
Would be easy if they were all Mechanical Beasts.
I doubt it'll be that easy, though.
It'd be easy if it were all Mechanical Beasts or Dinosaur Empire robots.
Naive. If they have any intelligence, they won't line up like that.
They'll likely deploy mechs capable of long-range attacks too.
Even Mechanical Beasts... I don't like them, they're tough.
As for space... we've lost contact with Londo Bell.
What!? Again!?
Has a battle started, maybe?
We don't know. We heard from Anaheim
that they'd won the battle on the moon...
but they dropped out of contact right after that...
We cannot reach Master Banjo, either. Now, what to do...
Just when we're about to start... Bad timing.
Is there any change to our operation?
...No, we storm in as planned.
Londo Bell succeeded in stopping the colony drop.
Now it's our turn to live up to that.
This is Bright we're talking about... He'll manage.
Kyosuke, you're worried about Londo Bell
too, aren't you?
Kyosuke, you're worried about Londo Bell too, aren't you?
Huh?
You sneak off to make calls, right? That's your girlfriend, huh?
Wow, Kyosuke, you're quite the sly one.
I see it now and then. Always when you finish maintenance early.
Hmph. How frivolous.
Tetsuya, keep quiet, you'll just make it more complicated!
...I wasn't exactly sneaking off to make calls...
Heh, you're always scowling, but you're doin' all right for yourself.
Joe, you sound like a dirty old man.
Isn't it nice? A man and woman torn apart, one on Earth, one in space!
Ahem. That's enough of that. Well, at least it eased the tension.
Heh, true. Well then, Commander...
Yes. ...All hands, stand by on deck.
The Gandor will now storm the interior of Jaburo...!
All right, let's go!
Show, let's take 'em all out with Aura Slash!
You've gotten pretty violent lately, Cham.
There's no turning back now. Let's go, Hayato! Benkei!
This'll probably be the last big battle on the surface.
I hope it leads to the end of this war, Shiro...
Yeah, let's end it. This fight...!
But... what if there's some terrible enemy in there...
You're gonna rain on our parade now!? Just get to Dangaioh's cockpit!
(The Einst's voice... only Excellen and I hear it... I can't tell them... not yet.)
